about: Off-arm overrides (rig.off_hand upper_arm, forearm, rest_direction, rest_reach) on a modified copy of the shipped spear rig, with the right main arm: FirstPersonOffHandTest (Java) and tools/tests/test_combat_preview_parity.py (the Python port) both solve these cases and check these numbers. No shipped rig uses the overrides, so the first-person parity golden does not cover them. A change to the spear rig's neutral hold or smash keys moves the numbers; re-derive them from the Java test's failure message.
